title: システム数学Ⅱ
subtitle: Mathematics for Robotics II
keywords: Vector space 2.Linear mapping 3.Linearly independence 4.Basis and dimension 5.Eigenvalue and eigenvector
educationalGoal: (1) Learn basic mathematics to analyze dynamic systems, such as robotic systems. (2) Acquire basic knowledge and logical thinking skills for designing control systems.
advice: This is a basic mathematics course in linear algebra. The course covers the following topics: 1. Vector space 2. Linear independence and linear dependence of vectors 3. Basis of dimension of baa vector space 4. Linear mapping and simultaneous equations 5. Eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
books: Textbooks: Vector Space, Kyoritsu Publishing Co., Ltd. (in Japanese) Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Completion of Linear Algebra I and II. Sufficient mathematical skills (vectors, matrixes, determinants, linear mapping, and simultaneous equations).

activityGoals.body: Understand concept of vector space and calculate vector spaces.
